changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ExecutionPredicate') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [api].[ExecutionPredicate]( [ExecutionID] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [ItemNumber] [int] NOT NULL, [PredicateID] [int] NULL, [uid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, [Type] [nvarchar](255) NOT NULL, [Name] [nvarchar](100) NOT NULL, [Inverse] [nvarchar](250) NOT NULL, [Message] [nvarchar](2500) NULL, [Success] [bit] NULL, [ExecutionItemUid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_ApiExecutionPredicate] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ExecutionID] DESC, [ItemNumber] ASC ) ) END
